_doc: One row per place the mod touches Katawa Shoujo. Each row is implemented by the named piece in mod/snake_eater/sk_core.rpy. ks_source = where the hook was confirmed (KS: Re-Engineered source, game/*.rpy). verified_in_game = seen working in a running copy.

rows.what: Adds 'Snake Eater: Operation Long Ramp' to KS's Mods menu; picking it starts label snake_eater
rows.ks_symbol: mods (dict, definitions.rpy python early); screen mods -> Start(lbl)

rows.what: Girls speak through KS's own Character objects
rows.ks_symbol: emi, ha, li, rin, shi, mi, mu

rows.what: Sprites are KS's own '<tag> <pose_expr>' images built from sprites/<char>/
Backgrounds are KS's own 'bg <file>' images built from bgs/
Music plays KS's own tracks by alias
Sound effects play KS's own sfx/ files
C key / CAMO button opens the camo picker during any line; the reaction plays in a new context, then the interrupted line resumes
Codec calls overlay KS's text box with MGS Delta's codec portraits and sounds
Finds the player's MGS Delta folder (SK_MGS_DIR from Melty) and the extracted cache; never ships MGS files
